_comment: Quran.ws terminology standard (github.com/quran-ws/guidelines), enforced with the quranic-terminology skill's audit_terminology.py. Every entry below is a judged decision, not a silencer.
_exclude: Data and build output, not code. pages/ and index/ are the quran-svg bundle verbatim; dist/ and web/pages/ are generated from it. docs/design/ holds the dated design spec, a historical record that should keep its original wording. docs/SEARCH-FOLD.md, conformance/search-fold.json and crates/qvp-core/tests/search_fold.rs are the search-fold specification shared with Quran Text and Quran SVG Elements: its case ids (hamza, wasla, uthmani-hafs.json, quran-tajweed) are the spec's own names and change in the spec first, then in every repository together.
_ignore_words: pos      — a byte position in the codec (qvp-format), not a part of speech.
stop     — reveal_stop / qvp_reveal_stop end an animation; nothing to do with waqf.
reading  — reading order in hit-testing and layout, not a qiraah.
diacritics — the theme slot for the `diacritic` mark family, which is its real name; not a gloss of harakah.
parts    — only survives inside Rust's from_raw_parts; every ayah `part` is now `fragment`.
part     — ordinary English: prose in the codec header, a Kotlin comment, and a loop variable in web/example/build.py splitting a page range; never the juz.
simple   — only inside SimplePathSegment (svgtypes) and android.R.layout.simple_spinner_*; not rasm imlai.
timings  — recitation segment timings passed in by the host; the engine stores no ayah_timing.
waqf_jaiz — audit false positive: it prefix-matches the CANONICAL `waqf_jaiz_mustawi_al_tarafayn`. The deprecated bare name is not used anywhere in this repo.
_external_names: ayah_markers  — the id of the medallion layer in the quran-svg-elements source SVG; a locator in their file, not our name.
data-*        — quran-svg-elements attribute names, quoted from schema/FORMAT.md.
Uthmani mushaf / word-by-word — prose describing the print, where the standard allows the established English.
Ya-Sin, Al-Baqarah — surah labels quoted in a demo and a test fixture, display forms rather than identifiers.
KFGQPC Uthmanic Script HAFS — a font family the demo asks the browser for; renaming it breaks the reference.
pause.fill   — an SF Symbol name Apple defines; the demo's play/stop button asks UIKit for it, nothing to do with waqf.
g.ayah-mark — audit false positive: the CSS selector splits to `g_ayah`, which it reads as the ayah_fragment concept.
_compatibility: parse_words_sidecar keeps accepting the pre-1.0 sidecar keys `uthmani` and `imlaei` alongside the canonical `rasm_uthmani` / `rasm_imlai`, so page data already shipped inside apps still attaches. Deprecated names keep resolving; they are not written in new code.
